svg.text: 1. Unsolder the round electret mic (2 legs), or cut its legs.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Multimeter on beep: the pad that beeps to the GND pin is −.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Shielded cable: core → + pad, shield (braid) → − pad.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Cover the joints with glue / tape so they cannot touch.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • No LM358, VREF or gain trimmer: the module's AGC sets

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the gain (40–60 dB) by itself, near or far.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Keep GAIN and AR open. Run the module from 3.3 V only.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Board, holes and wires are identical to rx_wiring.png:

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: only the mic is swapped for the piezo hydrophone.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Firmware and receiver.html do not change: choose WATER

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mode on both nodes (button, or 'mode water').

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Tip: solder a 2-pin header on the pads to plug in either

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the electret mic (AIR) or the piezo (WATER).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • ESP32 3V3 pin → 10 Ω → top + rail. With the 100 µF this is a filtered

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: supply (3V3A) for the module, so USB noise stays out of the audio.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Top − rail = GND. Only 3.3 V here: never put 5 V on these rails.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • R3 + C5 (3.3 kΩ, 4.7 nF) is the anti-alias filter in front of the ADC.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif
